question: Which of the following is/are NOT a parasitic organism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amoeba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **Amoeba** is a type of **single-celled organism** found in various water bodies.
 
• Amoebas belong to the **phylum Amoebozoa**.
 
• They are typically **free-living** and do not rely on a host for survival.
 
• Amoebas move and ingest food through a process called **phagocytosis**, using extensions of their cell membrane known as **pseudopodia**.
 
• Unlike parasitic organisms, amoebas do not exhibit a parasitic relationship where they harm a host organism to derive nutrients.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ticks**__

 __
 
• **Ticks** are small arachnids that are ectoparasites, meaning they live on the outside of their host.
 
• They feed on the blood of mammals, birds, and sometimes reptiles and amphibians.
 
• Ticks can transmit various diseases to humans and animals, including Lyme disease.
 
 
 
• **Cuscuta**__
 __
 
• **Cuscuta**, also known as dodder, is a genus of parasitic plants.
 
• These plants have no chlorophyll and rely on host plants for nutrients.
 
• Cuscuta wraps around host plants and forms haustoria to absorb nutrients directly from them.
 
 
 
• **Lice**__
 
 
• **Lice** are small, wingless insects that are parasitic on mammals and birds.
 
• They live in the hair or feathers of their hosts and feed on blood or skin.
 
• Lice infestations can cause itching and discomfort and are often spread through close contact.
